Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Shim Chang-min (Changmin) as the actor from TVXQ who starred in "Heading to the Ground." The visible information on the DuckDuckGo search results page mentioned Shim Chang-min as part of the cast, but failed to verify this against reliable sources. In reality, Jung Yun-ho (Yunho), another member of TVXQ, was the lead actor in the drama. WebSurfer did not cross-verify the information using independent sources that explicitly confirm both the actor's name and their TVXQ affiliation, leading to the error.
